request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Hello, I'm writing on behalf of the Poetry Society at USC. We are putting on Open Mic, a relaxed night where students can share poems and short stories, or simply come to listen. It is meant for students who write, and for anyone curious to hear their classmates' work in an easygoing setting. Your help would matter to the students who come because it would help us make the evening feel welcoming and comfortable, so that anyone who wants to share their writing feels at ease doing so. We would be glad to tell you more about the event.","contains_instructions":false}
